answer: The mesa schedule is applied in pearl and karst shows each instalment. A payout is split thus 49% arrives at settlement and the rest over 18 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A hostile operator hence cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3871 identities would post 3650 proofs and burn roughly 26 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
